name: Begaja po oskolkam dushi
source:
A visual novel is based on the unpublished short story of the same name. And it tells the story of a man who is lost not only in himself, but literally in everything.

The bottomless darkness of the depths of your own consciousness is slowly consuming you. You want to scream and call for help, but there is nowhere to wait for it.

Suddenly, help appears, it's... a wolf?

Will the hero of the story become the savior of this damned world? Will it be his undoing? Maybe he will peacefully rule a small state, or will he simply run away from everything?

It’s up to you to decide, but don’t forget, no matter how hard it is for the hero... he can remember everything.

[From [url=https://alexbrainhow.itch.io/running-through-the-fragments-of-the-soul]Itch.io[/url]]
